Name: Change Haley to Robin Buckley from Stranger Things
Author: TheAestheticDragon
Description:
This is a mod created by TheScarfedJirachi that I converted to content patcher, because I don't know how to use .xnb files on mobile.

In the future I hope to add an option to change her name and maybe gift tastes (to fit Robin's character better).

For now, the mod only changes Haley's look.

Requires SMAPI and Content Patcher

Manifest.Name: Change Haley to Robin Buckley
Manifest.Description: Changes Haley to Robin Buckley from Stranger Things.
